property.statement: The ordered, versioned YAML CatalogSourceRegistry is the single validated catalog declaration source. Batch config and catalog module views are projections from it; batch and RetrievalService use the same source-selection and seed-closure policy. Caller profile, explicit empty selection, disabled/missing/cyclic dependency status, and source identity remain semantic inputs and may not be silently defaulted or coerced.

selection_semantics.batch_none_default: Batch configuration keeps its existing prod_full default; the generic catalog selector accepts None as its existing default-source input and distinguishes it from an explicit empty tuple.
selection_semantics.explicit_empty: An explicit empty tuple remains empty; it does not expand to the default source set.
selection_semantics.profile_filter: Selected roots respect the supplied profile and wave/filter rules. Existing mandatory enabled seed dependencies may be included in dependency closure even when the seed itself is outside the root profile; this is the retained existing contract, not a new profile rule.
selection_semantics.disabled_or_missing_seed: A selected source with a disabled mandatory seed fails with dependency_disabled; a missing seed fails with dependency_missing; cycles fail with dependency_cycle. No execution proceeds by silently enabling/discarding the required seed.
selection_semantics.unknown_profile: Unknown profile is a typed refusal, including for empty requests.
selection_semantics.retrieval_none: RetrievalService.run_profile=None is unresolved and raises the existing typed catalog_run_profile_unresolved error; it does not inherit a batch profile.
